queries: Anthropic Reuters September 28 2026 S-1 12.65 4.6 billion operating expenses

sources_considered.why: Full Reuters report based on a prospectus its reporters saw.
Primary financial statements supply more precise figures and identify the rounding issue; retained as accounting-basis context.
Read in full, but its further-rounded Reuters summary adds no stronger evidence.

evidence_items.locator: Opening financial discussion; revenue paragraph and paragraph beginning “The AI lab spent”
evidence_items.explanation: Reuters reports nearly $4.6 billion of 2025 revenue and $12.65 billion of total operating expenses from the prospectus. Their ratio is exactly 2.75 using the speaker’s rounded inputs.

metric_scope.metric: Annual operating expenses, revenue and operating expenses per revenue dollar
metric_scope.units: billions; USD expenses per USD revenue

inputs: Reuters: 2025 operating expenses approximately USD 12.65 billion.
derived.rounding: Uses the published rounded inputs; ratio displayed to two decimal places.

evidence_items.locator: Auditor report F-3; consolidated statements of operations F-7
evidence_items.explanation: The audited statement reports $12.645 billion of expenses and $4.585 billion of revenue. These corroborate the rounded amounts, although their unrounded ratio rounds to $2.76.
